items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: we had Babe Kane - the ingénue

ctx.x: Well, that goes on the horn as well - and I could --- even if the arrangement was too tough for me to read, I would fake a part just as good--- you know, it sounded just as good. But, we had a tough floor show there because we had a line of, I think, 16 girls -- God, that's as many as you have in a big stage in a big theater--- and, of course, we had Joe E. Lewis -- first time I'd ever heard him ---that's when he was a young man and we had Babe Kane - the ingénue.
